title: Reversing Force
body: A body of mass $$m$$ has initial velocity $$v_{0}$$ in the positive $$x\$\$-direction$$. $$A$$ $$constant$$ $$force$$ $$F$$ $$acts$$ $$on$$ $$it$$ $$until$$ $$its$$ $$velocity$$ $$becomes$$ $$zero$$ $$after$$ $$a$$ $$time$$ $$t$$. $$The$$ $$force$$ $$keeps$$ $$acting$$ $$for$$ $$the$$ $$same$$ $$amount$$ $$of$$ $$time$$ $$t$$ $$until$$ $$the$$ $$velocity$$ $$becomes$$ -$$v_{0}$$.
